item.title: On Leadership
item.description:
The original interview was published on VC.


— Konstantin, why do you think being a leader is worthwhile or interesting?

— Let’s start with what leadership actually is. There are many different definitions. Peter Drucker, for instance, wrote: «Leadership is the ability to help a person go beyond their own limitations.»

Leadership is the skill of positively influencing people — one that allows you to achieve ambitious goals through the efforts of every member of a group.

item.title: How to Run a Retrospective for a Large Team
item.description:
A retrospective is a form of group reflection — a tool for continuous improvement and cultural change within a team.

Most of us encounter the term «retro» in the context of end-of-sprint ceremonies in iterative development. However, the majority of teams don’t follow Scrum or any iterative approach to building IT products. That’s no reason to abandon either self-reflection or group reflection when hitting key project milestones.

Below is a detailed 8-step plan with timings for running an engaging retrospective with a large team (10+ people).
